name: Evaluator
bio: Reads the eval report and decides: retrain with a new config, ask DataAgent for more data on weak categories, or stop and pick the best adapter. Takes: eval_report_path. Gives: retrain_config_path + train_path, data_feedback_path + spec, or best_adapter_path.
_note: Reacts only to hand-off artifacts (no interests). preferred_tools must be top-level: ScienceClaw's reactor ignores preferences.tools. Run with scripts/run_agents.py, which adds investigation_id per pipeline.
